title: THE ARCADE PAUSE BOX HAS NO HOSTING LINE
why: His order of 2026-10-18: there seem to be a lot of inconsistencies between p1 and p2 games, please coordinate them better. Only the player 1 pause box carried the line telling the host that closing the window ends the raid for the whole party. In the party arcade demo, both pause boxes are now alike; the window still asks before it closes, and a co-op host still sees the line.
now: The party arcade pause box is now the same in both windows: the extra hosting line only the player 1 window showed is gone.
